Hi Sarah — great questions. Quick answers up front, then a proposed next step: 

1) Mixed term / staged pricing: yes. We can structure a private offer with an annual committed baseline and an overage rate for consumption beyond the commit. We also support a pilot price that transitions to production pricing on a specified activation date or usage threshold. I'll include a one-page example term sheet.

2) Buyer approvals: Activation via AWS Marketplace private offer typically requires the listed buyer (procurement) to accept the PO and the payer account (often CFO) to sign-off for billing. In practice, many buyers require both procurement and the business lead (product owner) to approve. If Acme has delegated buyers or approval thresholds, we can encode that in the activation playbook.

3) Technical gating: For Redwood Private (VPC) we'll need network allowlists, a brief certificate exchange, and a handoff for data flow & KMS keying if you bring your own keys. Dedicated (hosted in our tenancy) is lighter — mostly IaaS onboarding and IP allowlist. Estimated technical onboarding: 7–14 business days for Dedicated, 3–4 weeks for VPC depending on change windows.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with our solutions engineer and Karthik (pricing) to align on the exact PO structure and signoff gates. Are you available Wed 1/13 10am PT or Thu 1/14 2pm PT?

I attached a draft term sheet snapshot (proposed_po_term_sheet.xlsx) to illustrate staged pricing.

Cheers,
Connor

Hi all — quick update from pricing/legal POV: 

- Pilot window: we can do a 90-day pilot at a negotiated pilot rate. We will include an automatic transition clause: pilot -> annual committed pricing unless Acme signs an amendment within 14 days of pilot end. That avoids activation ambiguity.
- Mixed billing: supported. We'll model an annual committed SKU and a metered SKU for overage; bill-to account will be the buyer on the PO.
- Delegated buyer activation: acceptable, but we require an internal Acme delegation letter (procurement confirms authority) and the PO must list the delegated buyer email on the Marketplace private offer. Legal does not need a special SLA exception unless customer asks for uptime commitments beyond our standard Marketplace terms. For reduced latency SLOs or reserved Dedicated capacity, we'll need a Reserved Capacity addendum and an internal capacity reservation (lead time ~3–4 weeks).

Connor/Vanessa — I'll prepare a one-page activation checklist and a draft amendment template for the pilot->annual transition. Sarah — happy to join the call on Wed 1/13 10am PT if that works for you.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
